attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create ONE high-resolution complete portrait-card fusion using exactly TWO inputs. Image1 is the unchanged original small portrait card and sole authority for actual head angle/roll, hair, facial hair, expression, clothes, decorations, light and crop. Image2 supplies user mascot identity/anatomy only. Replace only human anatomy with smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head/body, green-ringed black eyes and source-matching CLOSED mouth. Preserve actual source hair and real eyebrow HAIR, conditional facial hair and all clothes.
EXACT SOURCE FEATURES: BAREHEADED nearly frontal/mildly angled civilian bust with nearly BALD high receding crown, sparse very short GREY/BROWN side hair and real brow HAIR. Actual thin round gold/brown WIRE spectacles, clean upper lip/chin with no separate moustache/beard, serious CLOSED mouth. Dark CHARCOAL/NAVY OPEN suit over WHITE/PALE shirt collar and DARK BLUE/GREY tie with limited pale pattern/highlights beside note. Preserve actual sparse hair, source spectacles/head roll/light/crop, no cap or military uniform.
ANATOMY AND COLLAR: one COMPACT NEAR-ROUND head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin close beneath the mouth, immediately contacting a RAISED and BROADENED existing source neckline. Keep VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Do not copy human long neck or angular jaw; remove long tapered lower-face geometry. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, rolls, floating cloth, clipping or cream belly bib. Preserve actual source OPEN/CLOSED collar and fastening with coherent front/rear cloth overlap/contact shadows. Do not alter tie/collar/garment state to hide fit problems.
Keep complete original tilted dark frame, original opaque photographic backing in its actual color and lower-right cream note with faint indistinct marks and exact overlap. All originally solid internal skin, hair, headwear, clothing, collar, tie, fittings, frame, backing and note stay fully opaque; genuine alpha only outside complete card silhouette. Keep exact source light/crop. Fine genuinely indistinct markings remain understated; no invented visible accessories or hidden regalia. No readable text, labels, watermark, extra figures or comparison sheet.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged small primary, full raw master, paired sheet and white/cyan/alpha panels. Bald/receding sparse grey/brown hair, real brow hair, wire spectacles, clean serious closed mouth, source head roll, dark open suit/pale shirt/dark blue-grey tie and opaque frame/backing/note remain. The lower yellow face nevertheless narrows to a pointed V above the tie instead of a compact rounded short chin immediately meeting a raised broad collar. Queue a separate exact-master builtin art repair of this geometry, preserving sparse hair, spectacles, original head roll/light and actual garment. No visible internal alpha holes; fine tie pattern is not the rejection reason.
